name: setup-guard-mcp
description: Version-Aware Setup, Dependency Compatibility & Migration MCP Server for the JS/TS Ecosystem.
long_description: Your agent reads the wrong docs. setup-guard makes it read the right version. Analyzes your project's actual Node.js runtime, package manager (npm/pnpm/yarn/bun), lockfile versions, and configuration files to supply deterministic compatibility checks and tag-pinned migration facts.

tools.name: detect_project_environment
tools.description: Detect the project's Node.js runtime version, package manager (npm/pnpm/yarn/bun), locked dependency versions, and config paradigms (ESLint Flat Config, Tailwind v4 CSS-first, Next.js App Router).

tools.name: check_dependency_compatibility
tools.description: Verify deterministic compatibility (engines.node, peerDependencies, and deprecations) against the npm registry with ETag caching.

tools.name: get_versioned_setup_guide
tools.description: Retrieve version-pinned installation commands formatted for the project's package manager and configuration templates.

tools.name: get_upgrade_steps
tools.description: Retrieve tag-pinned breaking changes, migration steps, and official codemods between two versions of a library.

tools.name: search_versioned_docs
tools.description: Search tag-pinned migration guides, breaking changes, and deprecation notices for a specific library version.
